rows.title: AI Answer Rank

variables.label: Prompt
variables.description: The question typed into the user bubble. Up to about 60 characters keeps it on one or two lines.
variables.default: What's the best CRM for a small team?

variables.label: Answer lead-in
variables.description: The assistant line above the ranked list.

variables.label: Pick 1
variables.description: First pick in the original answer: a product other than the brand this video promotes.

variables.label: Pick 2
variables.description: Second pick in the original answer: a product other than the brand this video promotes.

variables.label: Pick 3
variables.description: Third pick in the original answer. It drops out of the top three when the brand lands.

variables.label: Brand
variables.description: The brand this video promotes, by its real name. It slides into the answer and takes the highlight.

variables.label: Brand rank
variables.description: The slot the brand lands in. Picks at and below it step down one place.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Highlight, monogram and check on the brand row, the one accent element.

variables.label: Ink
variables.description: Text colour; every placeholder surface is this ink at an alpha step.

variables.label: Ground
variables.description: Chat card surface; the page around it is the ground tinted toward the ink.

variables.label: Assistant name
variables.description: Name of the assistant answering in this mock chat. It belongs to the host product, never to the brand this video promotes.

variables.label: User message
variables.description: The question typed on the keyboard and sent. Around 40 characters keeps the measured pacing.
variables.default: How do I turn my HTML into real video?

variables.label: Answer paragraph 1
variables.description: First streamed paragraph. It names the brand this video promotes and says what that brand does.

variables.label: Answer paragraph 2
variables.description: Short second beat.

variables.label: Answer paragraph 3
variables.description: Lead-in to the list.
variables.default: What you get out of the box:

variables.label: Bullet 1
variables.description: First list item.
variables.default: A catalog of motion primitives you install and own

variables.label: Bullet 2
variables.description: Second list item.
variables.default: GSAP timelines that seek to any frame

variables.label: Bullet 3
variables.description: Third list item.
variables.default: 4K renders from a single CLI command

variables.label: End-card headline
variables.description: Closing card headline. A | breaks the line.

variables.label: End-card subline

variables.label: End-card CTA
variables.description: Closing-card button label, which names the brand this video promotes. Use the real name of that brand.

variables.label: End-card footer
variables.description: Domain of the brand this video promotes, letter-spaced at the very bottom. Use the real domain.

variables.label: Brand logo
variables.description: Transparent mark of the brand this video promotes, in the closing-card header.
